purpose: freeze independent Stage-D development, IID confirmation, and binding-centric OOD families before D1 model selection

development.use: learning-rate screening and checkpoint selection only

iid_test.use: single untouched confirmatory evaluation after all five-seed checkpoints are frozen

ood_binding.intervention: swap color-to-shape assignments while preserving color and shape multisets; use continuous edge and pooling-boundary-adjacent geometry
ood_binding.use: secondary untouched binding and geometry stress test

claim_boundary: Synthetic controlled tests isolate binding and geometry interventions; they do not establish natural-image or broad VLM quality.
